meta_state_law_citations_007.answer: Its function shall be solely to advise the Principal of any given school on internal matters and nothing in this Agreement shall be so construed as to authorize or enable the FAC to effect unilateral changes in County-wide educational policies as may from time to time be established in accordance with the laws of the State of Maryland. / Each professional person shall be provided a lunch period free of duty each regularly scheduled school day as established by Maryland School Law.
